user.title: Cache a camera in memory
user.description: Choose an existing camera. One JPEG or PNG frame is refreshed in RAM; no video is recorded. The source's provider may still receive snapshot requests.

abort.already_configured: This source camera already has a cache.

init.title: Camera cache settings
init.description: Changes reload this cache only. Disabling or unloading clears its frame from server RAM.
